scientific_integrity: Leading Gaussian smoothing and radial monomial diagonalization are prior literature; analytic asymptotic claims are derived here, finite checks do not prove limits. No independent mathematical or bibliographic audit.
scientific_limitations: One complex dimension; fixed positive parameters; equal-width concentric annuli symmetric in squared radius; largest eigenvalues only. General coalescing-maxima or Edgeworth literature might imply a comparable special result.
title: Universal cubic-root spectral drift at a two-annulus Fock localization threshold
